name: Can all interior doorways be widened for accessibility?

mainEntity.name: Can all interior doorways be widened for accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most interior doorways can be widened, but the feasibility depends on structural considerations. Walls containing plumbing, electrical wiring, or HVAC ducts may require more complex and costly modifications. Load-bearing walls also present a greater challenge, requiring structural reinforcement. Non-load-bearing walls are generally simpler to modify. A professional assessment from City Dweller, LLC will determine the best approach for each specific doorway in your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most doorways can be widened, but feasibility depends on structural elements like load-bearing walls, plumbing, or electrical systems.
